The '''Solanus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]], on the far edge of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Solanus]], a world with a sentient ocean.
